author: Dennis L. Huff
title: Numerical Simulations of Unsteady, Viscous, Transonic Flow Over Isolated and Cascaded Airfoils Using a Deforming Grid
review_scope: NASA TM89890 grid-velocity and GCL discussion around equation11/printedp5 inspected. It attributes GCL to Thomas/Lombard. Original1979 paper not read; no airfoil algorithm or code reproduced. Our 1D scalar moving-volume/Heun derivation is independent.

author: P. Korn and S. Danilov
title: Elementary dispersion analysis of some mimetic discretizations on triangular C-grids
review_scope: Governing linear equations, energy adjoints and AppendixB quadrilateral standard-C symbols/eq19–21 inspected. Use standard square C-grid only, not the paper triangular mimetic schemes. No global Williamson test or original code run.
